_readme: Source for the /lyrics/ pages. Edit here, then run: python3 content/build-lyrics.py. Lines are strings, or {"t": line, "note": small label}. A section with "repeat": true prints only its label. "x2": true shows a ×2 mark. "akan": true on a song shows the translation-coming note. Song order here is the order on the site. Optional "hook" overrides the line quoted on the index page. Optional "aka" is another name people search for; it goes into the page title.

songs.title: Defender
songs.sub: Jehovah Nissi — the Lord our Banner

sections.label: Intro
lines: Jehovah Nissi is His name
Our Banner, Banner is His name
Our Banner, my Banner, your Banner, our Banner

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, Your word is yes and amen
See how Pharaoh’s chariots and
army were cast into the sea
The mighty man in battle is You

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Your enemies, your enemies you see today
You shall see no more
Jehovah Nissi is His name
The Lord our Banner, Defender
Defender, Defender, Defender

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Who is this God of war?
Jehovah Nissi is His name
See how He will destroy
the wicked for His name’s sake

songs.title: Glory

sections.label: Intro
lines: Everybody sing:
Eh-oh, eh-oh, eh-oh-oh
Eh-oh, eh-oh, eh-oh-oh
I see Your glory! I see Your glory!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When I see the morning sun
When I see the stars at night
Everything around me
Shows me You are God

sections.label: Pre-chorus
lines: From the sky to the ocean
From the birds to the trees
I can see, I can see
Your glory all around me!

sections.label: Chorus
lines: I see Your glory! (Glory, glory!)
I see Your glory! (Glory, glory!)
Everything You made is beautiful
Everything You made is wonderful
I see Your glory! (Glory, glory!)
I see Your glory! (Glory, glory!)
Nobody, nobody greater than You
Nobody, nobody greater than You

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: When I see the mountains high
When I see the rivers flow
Every single thing You made
Shows me You’re in control

sections.label: Outro
lines: Hosanna, hosanna, hosanna in the highest
Hosanna, hosanna, hosanna in the highest
Glory, glory, glory, glory, glory
We sing glory, glory, glory, glory, glory
I see Your glory, I see Your glory
Everything You made is beautiful
Everything You made is wonderful

sections.label: Ending
lines: Hosanna, hosanna, hosanna in the highest
Hosanna, hosanna, hosanna in the highest
I see Your glory, I see Your glory
Glory to Your name

songs.hook: I see Your glory! I see Your glory!

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Sɛ ye daso tse nkwamu dea
Oseifo no anyay’en dea
Afi ako abeto yen biom

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Afi yi ɛbɛyɛyie
Afi yi yɛ maa fee
Nyame nti ɛbɛyɛyie
Afi yi ye ma fe

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Yɛ wo nkoa, yɛ wo adze
Yɛ wo Jesus a, yɛ wo adze
Mpɛmpɛn soa wo ne me
Abɛdu yi, eye Nyame na adom

sections.label: Bridge
lines: This is the year of blessings —
my Lord has said it, and it will surely come to pass

songs.title: Ayeyi
songs.sub: Mekamfo Awuradi — taste and see that God is God

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Ohiane waa nipa emfa me enye hwe
Me su fre wo na wasesa me shebre
Na wo yi me efi nia me suronyinaa
Den nkoa na mefayi wa ye

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Ayeyi ene ntomtom nkaa wo daa
Mekamfo wo din no daa
Ayeyi ene ntomtom nka wo daa
Mekamfo wo din no daa

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Oh bra na be so hwe na
Wo be huno se Awuradi ye
Nyira ne nia ode ne ho to osor
Sor hene nkoa so da nyinaa
Taste and see that God is God

sections.label: Bridge
lines: I shall not die but live to declare the goodness of the Lord
Ayeyi nkaa wo daa, ndase nka wo daa

songs.title: Onyankopɔn
songs.sub: Great God of power — You reign forever

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Mmepɔw kotow w’anim
Na abɔfo to w’ayeyi dwom
Ɔsoro bɔ gyegyeegye
Wɔbɔ Wo abotiri sɛ Ɔhene
Efi owia apuei kosi anadwo
W’anuonyam hyerɛn
Wo tum nni awiei

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Onyankopɔn kɛse na ɔwɔ tumi
Wo na wudi hene
Daa daa
Wo tim hɔ daa daa
Wo na wudi hene

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Ahome biara a bɛka sɛ wo yɛ Nyame
Adebɔ pae mu ka sɛ wo yɛ Nyame
Wone Onyankopɔn
Obiara nni hɔ

songs.title: Sesa
songs.sub: Sesa W’adwene · feat. Ablin Adade Boateng

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Obofuo no kakyerɛ Apostle John sɛ
Kyerɛw koma Sardis asafo no sɛ
Me nim mo ndwuma nyinaa
Me nim sɛ mo yɛ tiase ewu
Mon sakra mo adwen
Fi sɛ mere ba tisɛ owifoo

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Sesa wo adwen, sakra wo adwen
Nyame nim wo ndwuma nyinaa
Sesa wo adwen, sakra wo adwen
Nyame nim wo ndwuma nyinaa
Sesa ooo, onim wo ndwuma nyinaa

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Afeso kyerɛw ko ma Laodicia asafo
Me nim mo ndwuma nyinaa sɛ
Mo enyɛ nwun na mo enyɛ hye

lines.t: I will spit you out of my mouth

sections.label: Bridge
lines: Hold fast and repent, ooh — for you are neither cold nor warm
For I the Lord will vomit you out of my mouth
Sesa ooo, onyim wo ndwuma nyinaa

sections.label: Intro
lines: Praise God

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We give You thanks, O Lord God Almighty,
The One who is and who was and who is to come,
Because You have taken Your great power and reigned.
Praise God in His sanctuary,
Praise Him in His mighty heavens.
Indeed You reign over all.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Your kingdom stretches from shore to shore,
Your love endures forevermore.
With hearts lifted high, we’ll sing Your name,
Our lives transformed, we’ll never be the same.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Praise Him for His acts of power,
Praise Him for His surpassing greatness.
You are the One who heals our diseases,
The One who died for me. You are the centre of my praise,
My Redeemer and King. Indeed You reign over all.

sections.label: Bridge · key change
lines: Holy, holy is the Lord Almighty,
Your glory fills the earth and sky.
We give You thanks, O Lord God Almighty,

sections.label: Ending
lines: We give You thanks, O Lord God Almighty,
The One who is and who was and who is to come,
Forever we’ll proclaim Your holy name,
Our lives forever changed, all for Your fame.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The biggest Rock is You, Lord
The strongest Rock is You, Lord
The highest ever Rock
Indeed You are the Rock
Oh God, the Rock of Ages — mighty, mighty Rock, great God

sections.label: Chorus
lines: The unbreakable Rock
The unmoveable Rock
Indeed the Rock of Ages
Oh God, the unmoveable Rock
Indeed the Rock of Ages — mighty, mighty Rock, great God

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The mighty Rock is You, Lord
Majestic Rock is You, Lord
You are the greatest Rock
Indeed You are the Rock
Oh God, the Rock of Ages
Mighty, mighty Rock, great God

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God is good, all the time
In every season
Your grace divine
We pledge our lives forever true
To serve You, Lord, in all we do
Your love, Your love is real

sections.label: Chorus
lines: I love You, Lord
I love You, Lord
For You reign as King, Majesty

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: With joyful hearts we sing Your praise
Our voices raise in endless days
Your love surrounds, so vast and deep
In Your promises we trust and keep
We walk by faith, not by sight,
Led by Your word, our guiding light
